title: Grouping and aggregation
objectives: Make one row per group with GROUP BY and aggregate functions
Filter groups with HAVING and rows with WHERE
Leave out DISTINCT when GROUP BY already makes rows unique

exercises.prompt: For each region, show the number of sales (sales) and their total (total). Keep only regions whose total is over 500, largest total first.
hints: The starter's DISTINCT does nothing GROUP BY doesn't already do.
A test on SUM(amount) can't go in WHERE, which runs before the groups exist. Which clause filters groups?
Add HAVING SUM(amount) > 500 and ORDER BY total DESC.
